_comment: Backend notification templates. Placeholders use {single_brace} format as consumed by Go string formatting. Do NOT change placeholder names.
1001: BID {advertiser_bid} - {advertiser_name} - Budget Exhausted for this month for {group_name}: No recommendations were produced.
1001_grouped: BID {advertiser_bid} - {advertiser_name} - Budget Exhausted for this month for multiple groups.
1002: BID {advertiser_bid} - {advertiser_name} - Recommendations skipped because data is outdated, missing or a campaign is paused.
1003: BID {advertiser_bid} - {advertiser_name} - Margin minimum reached without reaching target KPI - maintaining previous recommendations.
1004: BID {advertiser_bid} - {advertiser_name} - Margin is below 30% or the target, as target KPI not reached. It can be reduced to as low as 20% as long as target KPI is still not reached.
1005: BID {advertiser_bid} - {advertiser_name} - Could not apply budget recommendation for campaign {campaign_id} {campaign_name} to ad platform {platform_name}.
1005_grouped: BID {advertiser_bid} - {advertiser_name} - Could not apply budget recommendation for multiple campaigns to ad platform(s).
1006: BID {advertiser_bid} - {advertiser_name} - Alloted OBA budget surpasses the total budget - plan is paused, action needed.
1009: BID {advertiser_bid} - {advertiser_name} - DV360 Insertion Order Start Date does not match the contract start date for campaign {campaign_id} {campaign_name}. Please update IO.
1009_grouped: BID {advertiser_bid} - {advertiser_name} - DV360 Insertion Order Start Date does not match the contract start date for multiple campaigns. Please update IO(s).
1010: BID {advertiser_bid} - {advertiser_name} - DV360 Insertion Order End Date does not match the contract end date for campaign {campaign_id} {campaign_name}. Please update IO.
1010_grouped: BID {advertiser_bid} - {advertiser_name} - DV360 Insertion Order End Date does not match the contract end date for multiple campaigns. Please update IO(s).
1011: BID/BPID {advertiser_bid} - {advertiser_name} - Data is missing for campaign {campaign_id} {campaign_name}. Previous day's budget still applies.
1011_grouped: BID/BPID {advertiser_bid} - {advertiser_name} - Data is missing for multiple campaigns. Previous day's budget still applies.
1012: BID/BPID {advertiser_bid} - {advertiser_name} - Recommendations skipped because data is missing for campaign {campaign_id} {campaign_name}.
1012_grouped: BID/BPID {advertiser_bid} - {advertiser_name} - Recommendations skipped because data is missing for multiple campaigns.
